Hubli (officially Hubballi) and Dharwad have grown into one of Karnataka’s most important industrial cities — the second-largest urban agglomeration in the state after Bengaluru. South Western Railway runs its zonal headquarters from Hubli. Engineering and steel fabrication firms operate out of Tarihal. Cotton gin machinery manufacturers line the Gokul Road industrial belt. And across NH 48, the Bangalore–Pune highway that passes through Hubli, construction and infrastructure work is constant.

Every one of these sectors needs porta cabins. Site offices for railway infrastructure contracts. Security posts at factory gates. Temporary admin buildings for road project teams. Labour accommodation for migrant construction workers. SAMAN manufactures all of these from our Bangalore factory and delivers to Hubli-Dharwad.

We are not a dealer and we are not a marketplace listing. We are the porta cabin manufacturer — the factory that builds the unit, loads it, and dispatches it to your address. ISO-certified since 2025. In operation since 2009.

Why Buyers in Hubli-Dharwad Choose a Direct Manufacturer

The choice between a local dealer and a direct manufacturer is not just about price. It is about accountability and quality.

A dealer sources from a factory, marks up the price, and hands over a cabin. If something is structurally wrong — a bad weld, a panel that lets in water, a base frame that is undersized for the load — the dealer points back to the manufacturer. You are left in the middle.

When you buy from SAMAN, you are buying from the factory. The cabin you receive is built under ISO 9001:2015 quality management (Certificate E20250218645). The structural MS frame carries a 5-year warranty. The panel and roof finishing carries 1 to 2 years. The engineered service life of the structure is 20 to 25 years. We hold NSIC registration (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005), GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR, and ISO 14001:2015 environmental management (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 occupational safety (E20250218647).

More than 500 prefab steel structures completed since 2009. For enquiries in Hubli, call +91 88616 22859 directly.

Hubli’s Industrial Zones and Who Buys Porta Cabins Here

Understanding where your site is located helps us plan delivery accurately and quote the right freight. Hubli-Dharwad has two main industrial estates:

Tarihal Industrial Estate (PIN 580026): Located on the Dharwad–Hubli road, Tarihal hosts engineering units, steel fabricators, auto component suppliers, and light manufacturing firms. Factory construction and expansion inside Tarihal is ongoing. Site offices for construction contractors and security cabins at new factory entries are the most common requirements here.

Gokul Road Industrial Estate (PIN 580030): The Gokul Road belt runs through Hubli’s western side and contains a mix of engineering, textile machinery, and small-to-medium manufacturing units. Material store rooms and watchman cabins at yard entrances are the typical need here.

South Western Railway zone: The Railway workshop, staff quarters expansion, and infrastructure upgrades around Hubli’s railway belt produce periodic demand for site office cabins — particularly for civil contractors handling station redevelopment and track-related work.

NH 48 construction corridor: The Bengaluru–Pune highway passes through Hubli. Road widening, bridge construction, and highway service infrastructure along this corridor generates demand for contractor offices at multiple site locations. These buyers often need 3 to 5 cabins at one order — one per site section.

Specifications

Our porta cabins are built on a mild steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections — the same structural steel grade used in commercial building columns and industrial shed frames. This is not thin-wall furniture-grade steel. It is structural material, factory-welded, with weld quality inspected before panels are fixed.

Frame: IS 2062 MS hollow section, factory-welded, anti-rust primed
Panels: 40mm PUF sandwich panel or cement fibre board (specify at enquiry)
Roof: GI sheet with anti-corrosion coating. Double-skin option available for sites with high sun exposure in Hubli’s summer months
Floor: Anti-skid chequered steel sheet or 18mm plywood on MS cross-members
Doors: MS powder-coated or painted wooden door with mortise lock
Windows: Sliding glass aluminium frame, fixed MS mesh vent, or jalousie louvre — any combination, specified per order

Standard sizes delivered to Hubli:

SizePrimary use
8 ft × 6 ftCompact guard room or meter kiosk
10 ft × 8 ftStandard security cabin or tool store
12 ft × 8 ftSite supervisor or inspection office
20 ft × 8 ftFull contractor office, single-phase wired
20 ft × 10 ftLarge site office with optional partition
40 ft × 8 ftLabour rest room or long storage unit

Non-standard dimensions are available. We build to your site drawing if the standard sizes do not fit your footprint or height restriction.

Customisation

A luxury porta cabin with full interior fit-out — AC, false ceiling, vinyl flooring, partition, and attached toilet — suits a project site manager’s office or a semi-permanent admin building. A basic MS security cabin suits a factory gate watchman post. We build both from the same facility. What changes is what goes inside.

Customisation options confirmed at enquiry stage:

Electrical: Complete single-phase wiring from entry point. MCB board, surge protection, wall switches, 5A and 15A sockets, LED fittings. We wire for your declared load — air conditioner, computer equipment, lighting.

Air conditioner provision: Cut-out in panel wall at correct height for split AC indoor unit. Bracket for outdoor unit on cabin wall or roof edge. Copper pipe sleeve through panel. Drain pipe outlet. You install the AC — we make the cabin ready for it.

False ceiling: Plywood panel ceiling or PVC tongue-and-groove board, fixed on MS sub-frame. Reduces cabin volume, improves cooling efficiency, covers roof sheet condensation.

Toilet module: Dedicated 4 ft × 4 ft or 5 ft × 4 ft toilet compartment built within or attached to the main cabin. FRP water tank on roof frame. WC, wash basin, floor trap, and plumbing roughed-in. Tile floor and walls inside the toilet module.

Partition wall: Plywood or gypsum-on-MS stud frame dividing a 20 ft or 40 ft cabin into two separate rooms with a connecting door. Each room can have its own entry door.

Ventilation: Fixed MS louvre vents or trickle ventilators in upper panel for passive airflow. Useful for Hubli’s hot-dry summer without full AC.

Exterior: Primer plus two coats gloss paint in any colour. Enamel name board or company logo plate fixed to exterior wall.

Delivery and Installation in Hubli

Dispatch point: Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099
Route: NH 48 north — Tumkur, Chitradurga, Davangere, Haveri, Dharwad, Hubli
Distance: approximately 415 kilometres
Transit: 5 to 6 hours road time. We target delivery within 4 to 5 days of dispatch from our factory.

The cabin arrives on a flatbed or crane truck. For cabins up to 20 ft × 8 ft, a standard 5-tonne mobile crane handles offloading and placement. Larger or heavier fitted cabins may need 7.5 to 10 tonnes. We provide the exact weight and centre of gravity with your delivery note so you book the right equipment.

No RCC foundation required for temporary or semi-permanent use. A levelled hard surface — compacted murrum, paver block, or existing concrete — is sufficient. For permanent or long-term placement, we include anchor bolt fixing plates in the base frame and provide the bolt pattern drawing so your civil team can prepare the plinth before delivery.

We deliver to Tarihal Industrial Estate (580026), Gokul Road Industrial Estate (580030), the Railway zone, and all Hubli-Dharwad Municipal Corporation addresses. Industrial estates often require advance vehicle entry authorisation. Let us know the estate’s procedure when you place the order — we handle coordination with your site supervisor.

Our wider porta cabin range covers all of Karnataka and South India from this same Bangalore facility.

For nearby cities with live pages and active deliveries, see porta cabin in Mangalore and porta cabin in Mysore.

Price Factors for Hubli Orders

Every cabin is priced to specification. No published price covers every configuration. What determines your cost:

Cabin size — larger footprint and height increase material and labour cost
Panel type — PUF sandwich panel is standard. Cement fibre board is heavier and more durable for long-term or heavy-use applications. Slightly higher cost.
Fit-out level — bare frame with door and window at the low end. Full electrical, AC provision, false ceiling, partition, and toilet at the high end. Each item adds cost in direct proportion to material and labour.
Doors and windows — number and type. A single MS door is the base. A double-leaf door, additional window, or sliding glass assembly adds to cost.
Freight — Hubli is 415 km from our factory. Freight for a standard 10 ft × 8 ft cabin is lower than for a heavy fitted 40 ft unit. We include freight as a separate line item in your quotation so you see exactly what you are paying for.

Send your size, use, and Hubli delivery address. Written quotation returned within 24 hours with a complete line-item breakup.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you deliver porta cabins to Tarihal Industrial Estate and Gokul Road?
Yes. We deliver to Tarihal Industrial Estate (PIN 580026), Gokul Road Industrial Estate (PIN 580030), and all Hubli-Dharwad addresses. Industrial estate deliveries often need advance vehicle entry passes — tell us the estate’s entry procedure and contact person when you place the order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle timing directly with your site.

Do you also supply to Dharwad, or only Hubli?
We supply to the full Hubli-Dharwad twin-city area and all of Dharwad district. Mention your exact delivery PIN when enquiring so we can accurately quote freight and plan the delivery route. There is no difference in our supply terms between Hubli city and Dharwad locations.

How does the cabin perform in Hubli’s weather conditions?
Hubli-Dharwad has a semi-arid climate with hot summers and a monsoon season. Our GI sheet roof is treated for anti-corrosion and will not rust under normal monsoon exposure. PUF panel walls provide insulation against heat. For sites with prolonged direct sun exposure, we recommend the double-skin roof option and an AC provision fit-out. The MS frame and base are hot-dip primed and painted — they do not degrade under the Hubli climate for the full service life of the structure.

Can you supply 3 to 5 porta cabins for a highway project at multiple Hubli area locations?
Yes. Multi-unit orders for highway and infrastructure projects are planned as a set. We confirm the size and fit-out for each unit, sequence the manufacturing to complete the batch, and dispatch in coordinated deliveries to your different site locations along the NH 48 corridor. Call us with the project scope — number of cabins, sizes, sites — and we plan the production and delivery schedule.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For porta cabins in Hubli, Dharwad, Tarihal, Gokul Road, or the NH 48 corridor:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. We respond the same working day. To use the enquiry form, include your cabin size, use, quantity, and Hubli delivery address so we can return an accurate quotation without a follow-up call.
